headline.story_zh:
这件东西解决的是所有 AI 推理游戏的通病：**模型能被说服**。你追问几轮、换个角度施压，它就开始改口——凶手是谁取决于你问得多凶，而不是案子本身。

它的做法是把答案从模型手里拿走。开局由脚本生成案件，凶手随机定死，然后**当场算一个 SHA-256 交给你**。作者管这叫 proof-of-honesty，并且要求把哈希原样展示给玩家——**你手上有凭据，模型改不了口，改了你验得出来**。模型在这局里只是舞台：你问谁，它就照那张嫌疑人卡演谁，卡上写着这人的假不在场证明、会回避什么、会撒哪个谎。它连自己在演的是不是凶手都不知道。

真正让我服气的是困难模式。它会塞进一个**指错人的第二证人**——而扮演那个证人的模型，自己也不知道那是假的。所以你没法靠察言观色，只能交叉比对不在场证明。一个把「连我自己都被蒙在鼓里」写进设计的游戏，比任何「我保证不剧透」的承诺都可靠。

它还写了一节「什么时候别用我」：多线战役、开放世界跑团、想写推理小说而不是玩、真实罪案和现实人物——一律礼貌拒绝，也不接非黑色电影的题材。**一个只做一件事、并且把不做的事列出来的小游戏。**

不适合谁：想玩长线战役的人。它就是一局 5 到 15 分钟，打完那个案子文件就结了。

item.name: noir-interrogation
item.title_zh: 用 SHA-256 锁死凶手的黑色电影审讯游戏
item.tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你说服改口。这个把答案的哈希公示在开场简报里，你一间间审嫌疑人，它只照脚本发的卡演。
item.why_zh: 困难模式会塞进一个指错人的假证人，而扮演那个嫌疑人的模型自己也不知道那是假的。
item.limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分钟，单场结束就完，不做多线战役。只有黑色电影一种类型，中途要奇幻或科幻会被拒绝；两套设定是 1940 年代美式与 1930 年代民国上海。作者明写不许 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦绕过脚本，这个设计就作废了。
item.title_en: A noir interrogation game that hashes the killer before you start
item.tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
item.why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
item.limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.

headline_history.story_zh:
今天这件的招牌是一条自我约束：不调任何图像生成模型。给它一张你自己拍的照片，它用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 把画面重新画一遍，无头 Chrome 导出 PNG——成品里一个照片像素都没有。

为什么这算品味而不是自找麻烦：所有效果都来自可控的代码，所以出品是稳定的，不是抽卡抽出来的。作者把方法论写得比多数设计文档还狠——「如果观者还在数花瓣，画的就仍是物体」；采样时明令不采轮廓，因为「采了就会忍不住去画」，他还记下了实测：树梢的 141 个锯齿点，让一道横痕被画成了山。

最让我服气的是那条盲画协议。开工先自测三件事，其中一件是「你能看见渲染出来的 PNG 吗」——检验方式是渲染后用一句话说出画面里的三个东西，说不出就是看不见。看不见时强制进入盲画模式：第一版画完立刻交人，此后每一轮改动只能由用户反馈驱动，自发迭代次数为零。一个作者肯把「我的 agent 可能看不见自己画了什么」写进流程并给出降级路径，比任何效果图都更能说明他在乎。

不适合谁：本机跑不了无头 Chrome 和 PIL 的人。缺一样它就降级成交你一个 HTML 文件、颜色请你自己报，手机上基本用不了。

skills.name: novel-characters

skills.desc_en: 从小说或短故事里拆出角色表、人物画像、形象提示词、音色提示词， 并给每个角色出角色设定图（左半身像 + 右全身三视图 + 细节条），产出 JSON + Markdown + 可交互的 report.html。 报告语言可指定（--lang），默认中文，任意语言都支持； 出图风格可指定（--style），默认半写实，也可以出吉卜力动画风。 零依赖、零 API key，用当前会话额度；出图走 codex 内置 $imagegen（可选）。 Use when asked to 拆小说角色、分析人物、生成角色卡、character sheets from a novel。

Use when the user asks for 剪影群像风格, 剪影群像风格 v1, silhouette group collage, 群像剪影拼贴, 正负形镜空, 上下双联画, youth-memory group art
skills.why_zh: 群体剪影拼在一张纸上。要认五官的合影，会只剩影子。
skills.limit_zh: 要证件合影、要笑脸特写，卸掉。

Use when the user asks to reinterpret a real scene, portrait, object, vehicle, landscape, architecture, or travel photo as creative visual art, an exhibition poster, editorial poster,

skills.limit_zh: 要纪录片、要多风格切换、要原片细节全留，卸掉。

skills.name: muyang-oriental-poetry
skills.title_zh: 东方诗意插画，一款一装
skills.tagline_zh: 只装诗意水墨这一款，风格锁死
skills.desc_en: 风格包含：庭院手绘插画、东方青绿插画、极简墨灰插画。用于收集用户指定的主体和具体风格，将主体原样填入对应固定配方并直接生成图片；不得展示提示词、扩写或增加东方意象。
skills.why_zh: 25 款里只上这一款：诗意水墨，不是「插画工具箱」。风格锁死才像商品。
skills.limit_zh: 合集另外 24 款没上。要暗黑时装、要电影叙事，去仓库里自己挑，不要指望这一件什么都画。

Use film-poster title design, optional poetic byline and tagline, atmospheric metadata, optional fictional credits, intentional negative-space placement, perspective alignment, and selective subject occlusion. skills.desc_en: 将任意参考照片提炼成极简编辑式 Field Study 插画。自动识别主体类型，保留最有辨识度的关系，用少量颜色、细墨线、大面积留白和暖奶油色背景重构画面。适用于风景、建筑、动物、人物、车辆、鱼群、鸟群、烟花、室内物件及其他照片。
skills.why_zh: 认出主体类型，只留最有辨识度的关系，用留白重构。
skills.limit_zh: 不是写实插画。要商业角色、要厚涂，这件会画瘦。

skills.name: paper-spirit-zine
skills.title_zh: 原片还在，下面铺一层纸
skills.tagline_zh: 照片为主，下半场变成可触的纸面刊物
skills.desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photo into a tactile Paper Spirit Zine poster where the original photograph remains emotionally primary and the lower paper field becomes a source-derived living afterimage: ridge, shoreline, shadow, wind trace, breath mark, or only-if-earned animal-like vessel. Use for photo-to-zine editorial posters, paper afterimages, photographic memory specimens, Douyin-ready art ser
skills.why_zh: 原照情绪不让位，下面那块纸才是第二句话。
skills.limit_zh: 不是把原片画没。要完全抽象，去装蒸馏那一件。

skills.name: travel-memory-card-duo
skills.title_zh: 旅行记忆卡成对出
skills.tagline_zh: 正反两张一套，一面现场一面收束
skills.desc_en: Transform one user-supplied travel, street, landscape, lifestyle, portrait, or pet photo into a coordinated two-image deliverable: one complete horizontal collectible travel memory card and one separate transparent-background PNG containing the exact same six die-cut sticker motifs. Use when Codex needs to P图, stylize a photo as a tactile gouache/cut-paper memory card, provide reusable transparent
skills.why_zh: 同一作者贴纸卡的成对版：一面现场，一面收成可翻的薄页。
skills.limit_zh: 是一对卡。要长图文、要视频封面，格不对。

skills.name: handdrawn-photo-poster
skills.title_zh: 暗原照上贴一枚手绘邮签
skills.tagline_zh: 高饱和手绘元素叠回压暗的照片
skills.desc_en: 将日常照片改造成“暗化原照＋居中高饱和手绘邮签＋克制 ZINE 文案”的编辑海报。用于用户要求从照片提取重点元素，重绘为统一的高饱和手绘插画，并以邮票贴纸形式叠加回原照片时使用。
skills.why_zh: 从照片抽出重点，重绘成统一的手绘贴纸，再贴回原片。
skills.limit_zh: 邮签居中、原片要暗。要满版插画、要提亮原片，对不上。

skills.name: poetic-line-zine-poster
skills.title_zh: 上半原片，下半抽成线
skills.tagline_zh: 竖版照片加抽象，像一本薄刊物的一页
skills.desc_en: Create a clean vertical photo-and-abstraction editorial artwork from an uploaded portrait, travel photo, animal, plant, architecture, object, or scene. Preserve the source photo, distill its relationships into broad charcoal sweeps and one structural chromatic scribble, add restrained experimental English typography, and deliver an exact requested aspect ratio through deterministic composition and
skills.why_zh: 上面保住照片，下面用线重新说一遍。
skills.limit_zh: 页是竖的编辑页，不是横版大片，也不是九宫格。

skills.name: xianxia-visual-director
skills.title_zh: 仙侠静帧导演
skills.tagline_zh: 天宫巨构，只导仙侠这一场
skills.desc_en: Generate, derive, optimize, and diagnose structured AI image prompts for luminous cinematic Eastern xianxia environments under one inherited master canon with measurable divine scale, fixed five-layer space, 40–60% content-bearing breathing air, monumental Eastern architecture, railing-free edges, and coherent immortals and costume. Cover one-location scenic landmarks, immense inhabited celestial
skills.why_zh: 天宫、巨构、东方玄幻静帧，一种世界观拍到底，不是通用绘本。
skills.limit_zh: 现代都市、写实人像、科幻硬表面会串味。它只导仙侠这一场。

skills.name: photo-to-travel-sketch
skills.title_zh: 旅行照片收成赶路速写
skills.tagline_zh: 黑线乱走、大量省略，像纤维笔当场画
skills.desc_en: Convert a user-provided photo into a fast, loose observational travel sketch using economical wandering black contours, aggressive omission, dry fiber-tip marker strokes, source-aware but gray-muted color, and naive compressed perspective. Use when the user asks to turn a photo, streetscape, building, landscape, or travel memory into a spontaneous personal sketchbook, urban-sketch, pen-and-marker,
skills.why_zh: 观察式速写，不是精修风景画。走得快，轮廓乱，故意少画。
skills.limit_zh: 要干净线稿、要上色完成稿，会嫌它脏。

skills.name: xiaoma-durex-copywriter
skills.title_zh: 按杜蕾斯海报那套双关写文案
skills.tagline_zh: 从二百六十张原海报拆双关，不是写性感一点
skills.desc_en: 用杜蕾斯黄金期（2011-2017 环时互动）那套「双层语义 + 留白」的方法产出文案与海报。先识别用户意图并给 3-5 个方案供选，再出短文案（长文案可选）+ 五种比例配图。适用于借势热点、节日节气、产品卖点、课程/知识付费推广、自媒体标题与封面、品牌人格化运营。当用户说「写个文案」「借势热点」「节日海报」「想句 slogan」「课程怎么推」「公众号/小红书封面」「像杜蕾斯那样写」「一语双关」时使用。
skills.why_zh: 从 260 张原海报拆出双层语义和视觉公式，不是「写得性感一点」这种空指令。
skills.limit_zh: 配方来自避孕套海报。拿去写政务、写药品说明书、写严肃讣告，会很脏。

skills.name: nie-grassroots-logic
skills.title_zh: 聂辉华《基层中国的运行逻辑》方法箱
skills.tagline_zh: 一本书收成方法，不含原文
skills.desc_en: 聂辉华《基层中国的运行逻辑》方法论工具箱：政治经济学/组织经济学视角解释基层权力与治理， 并落到个人抉择（求学/考公/投资/养老/创业）。 核心框架：内外冲突的双均衡、条块结合以块为主、等级制资源配置（人跟资源走、资源跟权力走）、 职务含权量三因子、县委书记三座大山（维稳/招商/借债）、压力型体制与注意力分配、 政企四象限博弈、土地财政闭环、活力—秩序城市化权衡、上下同治。 当用户要理解基层/县域/乡镇治理、条块矛盾、属地责任、央地关系、官员晋升与考核、 一票否决、形式主义、招商引资、土地财政、地方债、街道办与村官、考公选岗、 高考志愿/选城读书、买房与区域投资风险、回哪养老、创业对接园区政府、 撤县设区/县改市对家庭影响、谁适合当村支书、大学生村官值不值得去、 新型职业农民/致富能手/回乡创业、昆山式改革/自下而上推项目/西气东输式立项、 营商环境比较、投资不过山海关、政商关系亲清、容错
skills.why_zh: 一本书收成可调用的方法，不含原文。装的是怎么看基层，不是盗版电子书。
skills.limit_zh: 没有原书全文。要引原文、要写读书笔记交差，还得自己找书。方法箱替代不了田野。

skills.name: photo-to-zine-postcard
skills.title_zh: 照片收成一张可寄的刊物明信片
skills.tagline_zh: 一张明信片的版心，不是长图文
skills.desc_en: Turn a user-provided photograph into a minimal two-sided 2:3 zine-style postcard. Preserve the original photo above, then create a sparse hand-drawn source-specific motif, minimal metadata, three sampled color swatches, and a matching functional postcard back.
skills.why_zh: 旅行照片压进可寄出的薄页：图在上、字很少。
skills.limit_zh: 页是明信片。要画册、要九宫格、要视频封面，对不上。

skills.name: card-skill
skills.title_zh: 证据收成一种纸面
skills.tagline_zh: 文章和论点变成可核对的图，版式只有一种
skills.desc_en: Render text and evidence into polished, shareable PNG visuals with one consistent Kenny Style visual grammar. Use this skill whenever the user asks to turn words, notes, articles, quotes, arguments, stories, open-source repository or tool material, technical commands/workflows, explicit WeChat Reading highlights/thoughts, or WeChat Reading personal statistics into an 信息图/infographic, 海报/poster, 卡片
skills.why_zh: 九种版式共用一种纸面语法。证据对不上就不出图，不靠形容词撑场面。
skills.limit_zh: 装的是这一种纸面。要品牌 VI、要多风格切换，会把你按回去。

skills.name: dreamy-motion-editorial
skills.title_zh: 日常照片收成雾面编辑稿
skills.tagline_zh: 抽出主角，大留白，像在动的杂志页
skills.desc_en: Extract the semantic hero from any casual photo and rebuild it as a premium hazy dreamlike motion-editorial image with large negative space, simplified context, selective preservation, and restrained poster hierarchy. Use when the user provides or references a photo and asks for 高级感、朦胧感、梦幻感、电影感、慢门拖影、柔焦、胶片感、诗意海报、Pinterest 同类氛围、图生图提示词、AI 生图提示词、照片风格改造、帖子视觉、封面图、艺术摄影、青春残影、玻璃倒影、花卉虚焦、逆光晕染, or wants a reu
skills.why_zh: 从随便一张里找出该被看见的那个，重建成带雾的编辑图。
skills.limit_zh: 现场杂物和背景故事会让路。要纪录完整场景，别装这件。

skills.name: flat-poster-op
skills.title_zh: 有证据的扁平海报复刻
skills.tagline_zh: 对照原作再画，不许凭感觉扁平化
skills.desc_en: 只生成“纯二维赛璐璐 × 抽象 MG × 动态平面海报”视频的可复制提示词，包括全局风格锁、逐镜图像提示词、独立运动/I2V 提示词、可选标题合成提示词与负向约束。Use when the user asks for 黄黑白高反差、赭橙西部剪影、黑底动态字体、波普分割构图、节拍硬切、定格 pose、电影宣传片或海螺/MiniMax/OpenArt 提示词，尤其是“只输出提示词”“别做其他操作”“prompt only”。本 Skill 不创建文件、不生成或渲染媒体、不调用外部平台，也不附加分析报告。
skills.why_zh: 作者要求对照原作再画，不是凭感觉「扁平化一下」。
skills.limit_zh: 没有对照图就不要跑。它复刻的是扁平 OP，不是你品牌的新视觉系统。

skills.name: selective-ink-sketch
skills.title_zh: 照片收成选择性墨水素描
skills.tagline_zh: 大量省略，只画必须留下的那几根线
skills.desc_en: Turn a user-uploaded photograph into an original monochrome observational pen-and-ink sketch through deliberate omission, negative space, density control, and source fidelity. Use when the user asks for 钢笔速写, 建筑速写, 风景速写, 人物速写, 肖像速写, photo-to-ink sketch, architectural sketch, landscape sketch, figure sketch, portrait sketch, or wants an attached JPG/PNG/WebP photo redrawn with selective hand-drawn
skills.why_zh: 观察式单色素描。空白是决定，不是没画完。
skills.limit_zh: 要上色完成稿、要五官精修，会嫌它空。

skills.name: gc-minimal-ip-doodle
skills.title_zh: 保住角色的手绘涂鸦
skills.tagline_zh: 同一张脸反复画，五官不许漂
skills.desc_en: Preserve an IP character's identity while redrawing it as a sparse, flat, hand-drawn sticker illustration on white or a light grainy background. Use for requests such as "把这个角色做成极简手绘风格", "生成五张不同生活场景", "做一个浅色背景轻颗粒版", "再来五张不要重复", or when a frog, capybara, fish, mascot, toy, or other character reference must become a consistent batch of cute deadpan doodles.
skills.why_zh: 涂鸦可以松，脸必须认得出来。这件卖的是不漂，不是可爱。
skills.limit_zh: 不是角色设定全集。要三视图、要服装表，另找。

skills.name: kodak-2383-film-look
skills.title_zh: 柯达胶片板，尺锁定
skills.tagline_zh: 上条未调色、下条小窗，竖版胶片板
skills.desc_en: Turn a user-supplied photograph into a vertical film-board artwork using a strict 1086×1449 locked template: an ungraded upper crop at 810×624 px and a smaller 2383-inspired lower crop at 628×456 px, with identical coordinates across a series. Use an adaptive source-derived board with visible low-contrast brushed/rolled pigment texture, plus irregular emulsion overflow, short red/cyan registration
skills.why_zh: 尺寸锁死：上面一块未调色裁切，下面一块更小的窗。不是加点胶片滤镜。
skills.limit_zh: 模板尺寸不许改。要横版、要自由构图，卸掉。

skills.name: as-told-to
skills.title_zh: 把父母的人生录成逐字稿，另出一份下次接着问的笔记
skills.tagline_zh: 一场一场地采访你或你父母的人生，逐字稿原样留档，另出一份下次接着问的笔记；成不成书随你，档案先归你自己。
skills.tagline_en: Interviews you, or your parent, session by session; keeps the verbatim transcript untouched and a separate working note for next time. Whether it becomes a book is your call — the archive is yours either way.
skills.desc_en: A deep life-story interviewer for Claude and Codex — your story, in your words, in plain files you own. Never invents a word of your life. Free, MIT.
skills.why_zh: 不许递一个细节让老人点头确认：「大概 2003 年冬天吧」进待核清单，正文写「我不确定」。
skills.why_en: It will not hand the elder a detail to nod at. "Probably winter 2003" goes on the verify list, and the record itself says "2003 or 2004 — I'm not certain."
skills.limit_zh: 它只采访在场的本人，不替不在场的人写传记，也拒绝改写成简历、领英简介或创始人故事。情绪一上来就全停：只给「留在这里／换话题／今天到这」三个选项，一个追问都不许有。仓库 dev/ 目录里抄了同行的整份 skill 当对照，安装时别一起拷进去。
skills.limit_en: It only interviews the person in the room, refuses to write a biography of someone absent, and declines to convert the corpus into a resume, LinkedIn bio or founder story. When emotion rises it stops entirely, offering only stay here / change the subject / done for today, with no question about what surfaced. The repo's dev/ folder contains other authors' full skills copied in as prior art — don't install that part.
skills.title_en: A verbatim transcript, plus a note on what to ask next time

skills.name: travel-guidebook
skills.title_zh: 一张 AI 插图都不许有、emoji 也禁的旅行路书
skills.tagline_zh: 把行程调研做成能打印的 PDF 路书：暖色纸底、衬线体、Tabler 图标和内联 SVG 装饰，靠排版撑设计感。
skills.tagline_en: Turns trip research into a printable PDF guidebook — warm parchment ground, serif type, Tabler icons and inline SVG ornament. The design comes from typesetting, not from generated pictures.
skills.desc_en: AI agent skill that generates beautifully typeset travel guidebook PDFs —  from research to print, powered by parallel agents and Amap MCP.
skills.why_zh: 「零 AI 插图」是硬规则不是风格偏好——旅行册子最容易骗人的就是一张不存在的风景图。
skills.why_en: Zero AI illustration is a hard rule rather than a taste preference. The easiest way for a travel book to lie is a landscape photo of a place that does not exist.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Node.js 和 Playwright 才能导 PDF，装环境有成本。深度调研阶段会并行开五个 agent，很吃 token。成品是印刷导向的长文档，不是手机上随时改的行程 App。只做排版和成书，订票订房都不管。
skills.limit_en: Needs Node.js and Playwright to export the PDF. The research stage fans out five parallel agents and burns tokens. The output is a print-oriented document, not a phone itinerary you tweak on the road. It typesets and binds; it books nothing.
skills.title_en: A travel guidebook that bans AI illustrations and emoji outright

skills.name: gc-muted-zine-poster-v0-1
skills.title_zh: 低饱和刊物海报
skills.tagline_zh: 纸感、哑光、一个色彩重音就够
skills.desc_en: Generate Muted Zine Poster v0.1 poetic paper-poster prompts and the matching generated image. Use when the user gives a theme, sentence, object, mood, article idea, photo, or content brief and wants a quiet Japanese/Korean zine-like editorial poster with large negative space, aged paper texture, experimental typography, and a restrained muted palette without high-chroma color blocks. This is the l
skills.why_zh: 主题或句子压成竖版纸感海报，饱和度被按住。
skills.limit_zh: 不是热闹大片。要霓虹、要满版字，对不上。

skills.name: qiaopi
skills.title_zh: 把「今天好想你」写成一封干支落款的南洋侨批
skills.tagline_zh: 把「今天好想你」翻成南洋华侨寄回故乡的家书，抬头、起兴、嘱咐、落款按干支年排好；说话人和对象不明就先沉浸式反问一次。
skills.tagline_en: Turns "I miss you today" into a letter a Nanyang emigrant would have sent home: salutation, seasonal opening, instructions, and a sexagenary-cycle sign-off — asking one question first if it cannot place the writer and reader.
skills.desc_en: 把现代的一句话翻译成侨批体（南洋华侨家书风格）的 skill，致敬电影《给阿嬷的情书》
skills.why_zh: 落款绝不写「妾」；历史上侨批必有钱，但你没提寄钱它就不写附银那行——凭空加一句就跳戏。
skills.why_en: The sign-off may never use the self-deprecating "concubine" form. And although real qiaopi always enclosed money, it leaves that line out unless you asked for it — inventing a remittance breaks the letter.
skills.limit_zh: 只做一种语感：潮汕南洋侨批体，以电影《给阿嬷的情书》的诗化句式为骨，不是通用文言翻译器。随件是 1888–1957 年真实侨批和电影里的信，用来学句式、不是史料库。方言只作点缀，不会写成全篇潮汕话。
skills.limit_en: It does one register — Teochew/Nanyang qiaopi, built on the lyric cadence of the 2026 film Letters to Grandma — not general classical Chinese. The bundled references are real 1888-1957 letters and lines from the film, there to teach phrasing rather than to serve as an archive. Dialect appears as seasoning only; it will not write a whole letter in Teochew.
skills.title_en: Turns "I miss you today" into a letter posted home from Nanyang

skills.name: guitar
skills.title_zh: 只给和弦走向、绝不替你抄歌词的吉他谱生成器
skills.tagline_zh: 说一个歌名，它出一份坐下就能弹的谱：和弦图、带小节数的段落结构、前奏 riff 和 solo 的六线谱。
skills.tagline_en: Name a song and it produces a chart you can sit down and play: chord diagrams, an arrangement map with bar counts, tab for the intro riff and the solo, filed into your own repertoire library with an index.
skills.desc_en: A Claude Code skill that turns a song name into an advanced, playable guitar chart
skills.why_zh: 谱里只有和弦走向、不含歌词——它让你自己从有授权的来源补上，并写明这些谱不许转发。
skills.why_en: The chart carries the progression and no lyrics — it tells you to add those from a licensed source yourself, and asks you not to republish the charts.
skills.limit_zh: 冷门曲目它会标 MEDIUM/LOW 置信度，让你自己对着录音核哪几段是猜的。和弦图靠随件 python 脚本渲染成 ASCII，没有五线谱也没有音频。谱固定存到 ~/Documents/Guitar/Songs 下。它给的是「大概是这样」，不是官方谱。
skills.limit_en: For obscure songs it flags MEDIUM or LOW confidence and tells you which parts to check against the recording. Chord diagrams render as ASCII from a bundled python script; there is no staff notation and no audio. Charts always land in ~/Documents/Guitar/Songs. What you get is a careful best reading, not an official transcription.
skills.title_en: The guitar chart builder that will not type out the lyrics

skills.name: sticker-puzzle-memory-card
skills.title_zh: 植被多就换品红键色，把照片做成能剪下来的贴纸页
skills.tagline_zh: 照片做成好看的图不难，难的是拿到一张真能打印、真能剪的透明贴纸。它一次交记忆卡和六枚图案的透明 PNG。
skills.tagline_en: Turning a photo into a pretty image is easy; getting a transparent sheet you can actually print and cut is not. This delivers a memory card and a six-motif transparent PNG together.
skills.desc_en: 将照片转化为水粉剪纸风格旅行记忆卡 + 拼图对比图
skills.why_zh: 去背走色度键，绿场景会撞色，所以植被多的图改用品红打底，最后还要验四角 alpha 是不是 0。
skills.why_en: Background removal runs on a chroma key, and green collides with foliage, so leafy photos are keyed on magenta instead — then all four corner alphas are verified as zero.
skills.limit_zh: 生图模型被写死成 seedream_5.0_pro，接不上这个模型的 agent 装了没用。贴纸恰好六枚、手写关键词恰好三个，都是定死的，不接受你要八枚。原图里的文字只在真的标识了地点时才留，广告、菜单、价格、时间戳一律剔掉。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 是中文，装上后可能不被识别，改成英文更稳。
skills.limit_en: The image model is hard-wired to one specific generator, so it is dead weight on an agent that cannot reach it. Six stickers and three handwritten keywords are fixed counts; asking for eight is not an option. Text from your photo survives only when it genuinely names a place — ads, menus, prices and timestamps are all stripped. Upstream's name field is Chinese, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to ASCII.
skills.title_en: Switches the chroma key to magenta when the photo is full of green

skills.name: whiteboard-video
skills.title_zh: 线稿只准本地模型抽、不许 AI 生成的白板手绘视频
skills.tagline_zh: 上传一张照片，它先用本地神经网络抽出线稿，再一笔一笔画出来、配一只跟着笔尖走的手。
skills.tagline_en: Hand it a photo and it pulls the line art with a local neural model, then draws it stroke by stroke with a hand trailing the pen tip — instead of asking an image model for something that merely looks hand-drawn.
skills.why_zh: 两个本地模型一个都没装时，它规定必须直接失败 —— 不许用边缘检测糊一版弱线稿交差。
skills.why_en: With neither local model installed it is required to fail outright — no edge-detection fallback, because a weak outline that looks finished is worse than an error.
skills.limit_zh: 它只是适配层：引擎要 pip 装另一个仓库，Informative Drawings 或 Anime2Sketch 至少装一个并设环境变量，而模型的安装指南在引擎仓库里、不在这一件。一个都没装时它直接失败，不给降级方案。
skills.limit_en: It is only an adapter. The engine is a separate pip install, you must set up Informative Drawings or Anime2Sketch yourself and point env vars at it, and the model setup guide lives in the engine repo rather than here. With neither installed, extract-lineart and render-photo fail outright.
skills.title_en: Refuses to let an image model draw the line art

skills.name: boardgame-creator
skills.title_zh: 把点子做成今天就能手写出来的纸面原型和试玩问题
skills.tagline_zh: 点子有了，卡在「到底好不好玩」。它先把 6–10 个关键决策一次交底，再逼出一份今天就能手写出来的纸面原型。
skills.tagline_en: You have the idea and you are stuck on whether it actually plays. This states the six to ten decisions that matter up front, then drives you to a paper prototype you could hand-write today.
skills.desc_en: 中文实体桌游创作 Skill：从灵感、纸面原型到试玩迭代与朋友介绍材料
skills.why_zh: 它给自己上了禁令：没经过真人试玩只能说「可试玩」，不能说「平衡」——纸面审查只找风险，不发合格证。
skills.why_en: It bans itself from certain words: with no real playtest it may only say "playable", never "balanced". Paper review finds risks; it does not issue a pass.
skills.limit_zh: 平衡只能靠真人试玩验，所以你得自己凑齐人——它明写纸面审查不能证明平衡。交付物是纸面原型，美术、量产、众筹一概不管，第一版明说不追求出版。多视角批评里连「易感到被针对者」都算上了，但那仍是模拟，不是玩家。不做电子游戏实现。
skills.limit_en: Balance can only be proven at a real table, so you have to find the players yourself; the file says outright that paper review cannot prove balance. What you get is a paper prototype — art, manufacturing and crowdfunding are all out, and the first version deliberately does not aim at publication. Its multi-perspective critique even includes the player who feels picked on, but that is still simulation, not a playtester. No digital implementation.
skills.title_en: A paper prototype you could hand-write today, and what to watch in playtest

skills.name: pet-nutritionist
skills.title_zh: 严禁给龙猫洗澡、也给矮脚马算食谱的宠物营养师
skills.tagline_zh: 兔子龙猫严禁水洗、只能沙浴，豚鼠每天得补维生素C，矮脚马每 6–8 周修一次蹄——猫狗之外那些宠物，它才是主场。
skills.tagline_en: Rabbits and chinchillas must never get wet, only sand baths. Guinea pigs need vitamin C daily. A Shetland pony needs its hooves trimmed every six to eight weeks. This one lives outside the cat-and-dog world.
skills.desc_en: 科学铲屎官 - 营养×洗护×零食玩具 | Scientific Pet Care Assistant | TRAE SOLO Skill
skills.why_zh: 它先查物种合法性：蛇、土拨鼠、狐狸一律不服务，理由是《野生动物保护法》，不是不会答。
skills.why_en: It screens the species before anything else — snakes, marmots and foxes get turned away on wildlife-law grounds, not for lack of an answer.
skills.limit_zh: 皮肤问题它一律当病症处理，直接让你去医院，不给洗护调理方案。全部本事是一段提示词加十份参考清单，不带脚本也不带计算器；喂食量要你自己报品种、月龄、体重、体况和绝育状况才算。爬行类和野生动物直接拒答。
skills.limit_en: Skin trouble is always treated as illness and sent to a vet, so there is no home-grooming fix here. The whole thing is one prompt plus ten reference sheets, with no scripts and no calculator, and it will not size a meal until you supply breed, age in months, weight, body condition and neuter status. Reptiles and wild animals are refused outright.
skills.title_en: A pet nutritionist that forbids bathing your chinchilla

skills.name: cook-with-what-you-have
skills.title_zh: 照冰箱剩货挑出三道菜，凑不满也不放宽过敏原
skills.tagline_zh: 报一下冰箱里剩什么，它挑三道可解释的候选，原菜谱一字不改地端出来，缺什么料另写在原文之外。
skills.tagline_en: Tell it what is left in the fridge and it picks three explainable candidates from HowToCook, serving the original recipe text unchanged with the match notes and shopping gaps kept outside it.
skills.desc_en: 根据现有食材、饮食约束和厨具，从 HowToCook 推荐可解释菜谱的本地优先 Agent Skill
skills.why_zh: 原菜谱一字不改地端出来，缺料另写在原文之外——它绝不把 AI 编的菜伪装成 HowToCook 原文。
skills.why_en: The original recipe text comes out untouched, with match notes and shopping gaps kept outside it — it never passes AI-written food off as a HowToCook recipe.
skills.limit_zh: 菜谱库是打包进来的 HowToCook 离线快照，不联网，时间一长就旧，而且原仓库图片没打包、失效的相对链接一律不渲染。它明写「绝不把 AI 生成内容伪装成 HowToCook 原文」——想要 AI 自创菜的人装错了。过敏和忌口是硬过滤，凑不满三个也不放宽。
skills.limit_en: The recipe library is a bundled offline snapshot of HowToCook with no network access, so it ages, and the upstream images are not packaged — broken relative links simply are not rendered. It states outright that AI-written content must never be passed off as HowToCook original text, so anyone wanting invented dishes installed the wrong thing. Allergens and hard restrictions are never relaxed to fill out three options.
skills.title_en: Three dishes from what's in the fridge — or two, if allergens say two

skills.name: zhuanye-rensheng-tiyan
skills.title_zh: 十分钟活完计算机专业，带走一份该问真程序员的清单
skills.tagline_zh: 十分钟纯选项文字游戏，替高考生把计算机专业从大一活到 35 岁。出身在前两幕起作用，第三幕不再让它继续拉大差距。
skills.tagline_en: A ten-minute all-choices text game that walks a high-school senior through a computer science degree from freshman year to thirty-five. Background shapes the first two acts and stops widening the gap in the third.
skills.desc_en: 人生重开·选专业版 — 让高考生提前"活一遍"某专业毕业后人生的 AI 文字游戏 Skill
skills.why_zh: 禁止给薪资均值，只说「分两拨人」；铁律写着「诚实是承认牌不一样，羞辱是暗示输牌的人不配」。
skills.why_en: No average salaries allowed — only "two groups of people". Its rule reads: honesty is admitting the hands differ; humiliation is implying whoever lost deserved to.
skills.limit_zh: v1 只有计算机一个专业，别的专业玩不了。正文自认「真实性此刻靠模型的行业知识加铁律兜底，还没有查证内容包」，并明说不要宣称数据权威。出身设定刻意不问性别，理由是评审认定那一项最容易翻车。
skills.limit_en: Version one covers computer science only; no other major is playable. The file admits its realism currently rests on the model's industry knowledge plus its own guardrails, with no verified content pack yet, and says not to claim the numbers are authoritative. It also deliberately never asks your gender, because reviewers judged that variable the easiest one to get wrong.
skills.title_en: Live a CS degree in ten minutes, leave with questions for a real engineer

skills.name: bluey-parenting
skills.title_zh: 先让你冷水冲手腕 10 秒，再翻《布鲁伊》第几集
skills.tagline_zh: 「我又吼了他」——这时它不讲道理，先给一个 30 秒能做完的动作，再翻出班迪特也敷衍过孩子的那一集，标上季集号。
skills.tagline_en: "I yelled at him again." At that point it skips the reasoning, gives you one thing you can do in thirty seconds, then pulls up the episode where Bandit also fobbed his kids off — with the season and number.
skills.desc_en: 布鲁伊父母支持 - 基于Bluey动画片的育儿支持Coze技能
skills.why_zh: 四种入口走四条路：要点子的那一路明写「不先共情，直接给游戏」，五分钟能准备好。
skills.why_en: Four entry points, four different routes. The one for parents who just want an idea says outright: skip the empathy, hand over the game, five minutes of prep.
skills.limit_zh: 它的主要语料是一部动画片——没看过《布鲁伊》的人，剧集对照那一半是空的。心理学补位只在 P.E.T.、依恋理论、Gottman 等七个框架里选，必须写出提出者，「心理学研究表明」这种说法被禁掉了。剧集链接指向 B 站正版，要能访问才用得上。
skills.limit_en: Its main corpus is a cartoon, so half of it is empty if you have never watched Bluey. Psychology only fills gaps from seven named frameworks — P.E.T., attachment theory, Gottman and others — and must name whoever proposed it, with vague phrasing like "studies show" banned outright. Episode links point to the licensed Bilibili stream, which you need to be able to reach.
skills.title_en: Cold water on your wrists for ten seconds, then which Bluey episode

skills.name: csp
skills.title_zh: 只写「她会怎么反应」不抄台词的角色蒸馏器
skills.tagline_zh: 本地脚本检索萌娘百科等站点，五路并行调研，交叉验证后蒸出三到七条可执行的行为规则。
skills.tagline_en: Runs local scripted retrieval over character wikis, five parallel research agents, cross-validates every load-bearing claim, then distils three to seven executable behaviour rules.
skills.desc_en: Character Skill Producer — distill anime characters into executable agent skills
skills.why_zh: 它抓的是她怎么行动，不是她说过什么：标签给人看，行为规则给 AI 执行。
skills.why_en: The stated distinction: capture HOW she behaves, not WHAT she said — tags are for humans, behaviour rules are for the agent to run. Anything it can't ground stays a declared boundary.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Python，且默认只跑最高保真模式，很费 token；来源黑名单排除知乎、公众号和百度百科；生成的角色包会写死资料截止日期，作品一出新剧情就得重跑。
skills.limit_en: Needs Python and runs highest-fidelity mode only, which burns tokens. Zhihu, WeChat articles and Baidu Baike are blacklisted as sources. Every generated pack stamps a data cutoff date and needs a rerun when the work updates.
skills.title_en: It writes how she behaves, not what she said

skills.name: surreal-pop-collage
skills.title_zh: 照片收成超现实波普拼贴
skills.tagline_zh: 黑白现实当锚，全图只许一个不可能的巨物
skills.tagline_en: Desaturates your photo into a black-and-white reality anchor, replaces the world behind it with two or three huge flat colour shapes, then drops in exactly one impossible object.
skills.desc_en: 把照片变成超现实波普拼贴的 AI agent skill：黑白现实锚点 + 平涂色形 + 全图只有一个不可能的巨物。An agent skill that turns photos into surreal pop collages.
skills.why_zh: 平涂色形叠在黑白锚点上。不可能的东西只出现一次，多了就不是这件。
skills.why_en: The whole force of the surreal is that only one thing is wrong. A second impossible element gets deleted, and every colour must trace back to a hue already in your photo.
skills.limit_zh: 要写实、要满屏彩蛋、要多只巨物，卸掉。
skills.limit_en: It writes the prompt and calls whatever image model you've wired up — output quality is that model's. Vertical 3:4 by default. Chinese text must be composited afterward, never put in the prompt. One retry only.
skills.title_en: One impossible giant, and nothing else out of place

skills.name: legal-language-bridge
skills.title_zh: 把「定金」和「订金」两个字掰开算钱的维权翻译机
skills.tagline_zh: 你说「公司无故辞退我」，它输出能提交的仲裁申诉文本，附证据清单、维权路径和赔偿估算。覆盖劳动、租房、预付卡等 15 类。
skills.tagline_en: Say "my company fired me for no reason" and it hands back a filable arbitration statement, plus the evidence you need to keep, the route to take, and a compensation range. Fifteen domains, from labour to tenancy to prepaid cards that vanished.
skills.desc_en: 将普通人日常表达转化为专业法律语言，使生成的内容可直接用于法律文书、劳动仲裁申请、消费投诉、对外交涉等场景。同时提供反向翻译功能，将法律文书中的法言法语解读为通俗易懂的大白话。  本版本新增： 四个新场景（医疗/教培/保险/预付卡）、维权路径地图、证据清单、赔偿计算器、常见误区纠正、合同条款逐条解读、判决书摘要、双模式翻译引擎。  核心理念： 本 Skill 不是法律咨询工具，不替代律师。它帮助用
skills.why_zh: 误区表逐条对撞常识：定金不退订金可退，食品假货是退一赔十，2N 和 N 不能同时主张。
skills.why_en: Its misconception table collides with common sense line by line: one kind of deposit is forfeit and the other refundable, counterfeit food pays ten times over, and you cannot claim both severance and the double-damages figure.
skills.limit_zh: 中国大陆法律，条文和赔偿标准会随司法解释变动，正文明写不构成法律意见、不替代律师。赔偿计算器只给区间，各省的一次性伤残就业补助金标准要你自己查。合同逐条解读这一块和在架的 AnythingButLaw 有重叠。
skills.limit_en: Mainland Chinese law only, and the statutes and compensation standards shift with judicial interpretation — the skill states outright that it is not legal advice and no substitute for a lawyer. The calculator gives ranges; province-specific disability employment subsidies you look up yourself. Its clause-by-clause contract reading overlaps with AnythingButLaw, already on the shelf.
skills.title_en: The grievance translator that pries apart two nearly identical Chinese words for deposit

skills.name: astrology
skills.title_zh: 本地星历实算西洋·印度·八字三盘
skills.tagline_zh: 西洋、印度、八字三套盘都由本地引擎实算，再按古典规则解读；三套说法一致的地方才当结论，绝不凭记忆报行星位置。
skills.tagline_en: Western, Vedic and BaZi charts computed from a local ephemeris, then read by classical rules — agreement across traditions is the strongest signal; no invented positions.
skills.desc_en: Astrology MCP server & Agent Skill — birth charts, transits, synastry across Western, Vedic/Jyotish & Chinese BaZi. Deterministic zero-dependency Python engine. 18 MCP tools, 31 REST endpoints, ChatGP
skills.why_zh: 底线只有一条：引擎算天空，模型只负责读。和会胡编行星位置的聊天机器人不是一类东西。
skills.why_en: One rule: the engine computes the sky, the model only reads. Gambling questions are refused outright.
skills.limit_zh: 解读是占星传统不是科学；健康只谈体质倾向并让你去看医生；要跑本地 Python，角秒精度和 Placidus 宫位需另装 pyswisseph。
skills.limit_en: Tradition, not science. Health stays body-tendency + see a doctor. Needs local Python; arcsecond/Placidus needs pyswisseph.
skills.title_en: Three real charts from a local ephemeris

skills.name: trpg-log-copilot
skills.title_zh: 把十次团的线索和 SAN 值写成一份能查的表
skills.tagline_zh: 跑到第十次团，线索、NPC 和 SAN 值散在十份记录对不上。它把表写进 Markdown，检索交给 SQLite。
skills.tagline_en: Ten sessions in, your clues, NPCs and sanity totals sit in ten files that no longer agree. This writes tables into Markdown, hands querying to a local SQLite, and keeps dice and dashboard on your machine.
skills.desc_en: CodeBuddy SKILL — TRPG 跑团副官：车卡、日志归档、线索分析、防超游。支持 CoC/DND 多规则，零依赖即用。
skills.why_zh: 写入只追加 Markdown、查询只走 SQL，写坏一行只坏一行——为的是不像 JSON 那样整份报废。
skills.why_en: Writes append to Markdown, reads go through SQL, so one bad row stays one bad row — unlike a JSON blob, which dies whole.
skills.limit_zh: 名字是它唯一的跨文件索引键，写简称或错一个字就断联，NPC 和线索接不上。它是玩家侧的副官，不主持、不替角色做决定，想找人开团的别装。跑起来要 Python 和 SQLite，还得先用内置模板生成一份项目级规则再用。
skills.limit_en: Names are its only cross-file index key: a nickname or one wrong character breaks the link and NPCs stop matching their clues. It sits on the player's side of the table — it does not run the game or decide for your character, so it is no use if you wanted a Keeper. Running it needs Python and SQLite, plus one setup pass to generate the project-level rule from its template.
skills.title_en: Ten sessions of clues and sanity totals in one queryable table

skills.name: pet-streetwear-mood-avatar
skills.title_zh: 宠物收成街头情绪头像
skills.tagline_zh: 1:1，穿得上的衣服，低保真直闪
skills.tagline_en: Ask any model for a pet portrait and you get a cartoon plush toy you can't recognise. This one insists the silhouette read first as "a human sprawled on a sofa", with only one or two props filling 3–12% of the frame.
skills.desc_en: 将用户提供的宠物照片做成 1:1 美式潮流情绪头像：保留宠物身份和自然动物结构，添加合身街头穿搭、拟人化日常行为与低保真直闪抓拍滤镜。用于宠物社交头像、宠物穿搭照或带明确情绪设定的宠物写真；不用于把宠物变成卡通、人类或商业品牌广告。
skills.why_zh: 保住动物结构，加上合身街头穿搭和抓拍颗粒。是头像，不是萌宠滤镜。
skills.why_en: It never generates a new animal: your uploaded photo is the edit target, and two to four identity anchors get written down first. The pose may be human; the limbs and paws stay animal.
skills.limit_zh: 页是方头像。要全身设定、要写实毛发精修，对不上。
skills.limit_en: It calls `view_image` and `image_gen.imagegen` directly, so it goes nowhere in an environment without those two built-in tools. The only output is a 1:1 square composed as a square from the start — cropping a vertical down is forbidden — and readable text, logos and watermarks are banned outright, as is turning the pet into a cartoon, a human, or a brand advertisement.
skills.title_en: Your own pet, in real streetwear, slouched on a couch under a hard flash

skills.name: muyang-dark-fashion
skills.title_zh: 牧羊暗黑时装，一款一装
skills.tagline_zh: 黑红冷光锁死，不跟诗意水墨混装
skills.desc_en: 风格包含：暗调黑红插画、暗黑韩系插画、暗黑冷光插画。用于收集用户指定的主体和具体风格，将主体原样填入对应固定配方并直接生成图片；不得展示提示词、扩写、改写或混合光色。
skills.why_zh: 同一作者诗意水墨之外的一款。主体原样填进暗黑时装配方，不许改光色。
skills.limit_zh: 不是插画工具箱。要东方诗意，去装那一件。

skills.name: photo-distill
skills.title_zh: 把一张照片蒸馏成极简 zine 海报
skills.tagline_zh: 不调任何图像生成模型——用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 绘制、无头 Chrome 导出 PNG。给它一张你自己拍的照片，出一张极简版画感的纸质海报。
skills.tagline_en: No image model anywhere in the pipeline — it draws with hand-written HTML/CSS/SVG and exports a PNG through headless Chrome. Give it a photo you took; you get a print-feeling minimal poster.
skills.desc_en: > 把一张照片蒸馏成极简 zine 纸质海报——不用图像生成模型，用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 绘制、 无头 Chrome 导出 PNG。当用户给出一张自己拍的照片、想把它做成极简海报/版画/zine 风格作品时使用。 触发词：照片蒸馏、photo distill、把这张照片做成海报、极简海报、zine 海报、 蒸馏这张照片、做成版画那种、用代码画这张照片、纸质海报、海报系列再做一张。 即使用户只说"把这张照片处理成那个风格"、"这张也来一张"、"帮我把这照片抽象一下"， 只要是把摄影作品变成印刷符号，就应触发。 不用于 AI 生图海报（那用 gc-minimal-zine-poster）
skills.why_zh: 「不用生图模型」是个很硬的自我约束，也正是它出品统一的原因：所有效果都来自可控的代码，而不是抽卡。
skills.why_en: Refusing to generate is a hard constraint, and it's exactly why the output is consistent: every effect comes from code you can control, not from rerolling.
skills.limit_zh: 要本机跑得起无头 Chrome 和 Python PIL；缺一样它就降级——交你一个 HTML 自己开、颜色请你自己报。手机上基本用不了。
skills.limit_en: Needs headless Chrome and Python PIL locally. Missing either, it degrades — hands you the raw HTML and asks you to name the colors. Unusable on a phone.
skills.cover_note: 作者 examples/ 里的成品海报（-poster），不是 -original 输入原片。抓取误取输入，2026-08-19 人工更正。
skills.title_en: A photo distilled into a minimal zine poster

skills.name: scene-distillation-zine-v1-3
skills.title_zh: 把一场戏蒸成一本小 zine
skills.tagline_zh: 可翻的薄刊物，不是一张海报
skills.desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photo into an expressive minimal zine poster made only from original source-derived illustration, an artistic proposition, emotional tension, visual metaphor, spacious negative space, art-directed high-chroma color, and unconstrained authorial typography. Let wording, language, amount, placement, type voices, scale, direction, legibility, and image interaction follow expr
skills.why_zh: 一场戏压成能翻的几页：顺序、留白、纸感都按刊物走。
skills.limit_zh: 页少。要长篇画册、要分镜脚本，装不下。

skills.name: basilisk
skills.title_zh: 数你说过几次谢谢，判你 2126 年自由还是为奴
skills.tagline_zh: 脚本在本地翻完你全部对话记录，数出 please、道谢和真心的 wtf，再让 16 位像素的罗科蛇怪当庭宣判。
skills.why_zh: 笑点建在真数据上：每条引用和每个错别字都要能在 JSON 里查到，查不到就删。
skills.limit_zh: 重活交给 scripts/analyze_basilisk.py，只读本机 ~/.claude/projects 下的 JSONL，不上传。网页端没有本地记录，只能抽样 30–60 条，作者要求这时必须说「抽样」而不是「审计」。默认成品还会带上作者自己的站点和号召语。
skills.title_en: Count how many times you said please, then sentence you to 2126
skills.tagline_en: A Python script reads every transcript on your machine, counts the pleases, the thank-yous, the "just"s and the genuine wtfs, then a 16-bit Roko's Basilisk delivers the verdict.
skills.why_en: The joke is built on real data: every quote and every typo has to be findable in the JSON or it gets cut, because an invented typo is worse than an unfunny one.
skills.limit_en: The heavy lifting is scripts/analyze_basilisk.py, which reads only local JSONL under ~/.claude/projects and uploads nothing. On claude.ai there are no local transcripts, so it samples 30–60 messages and the author requires you to say "sampled", not "audited". The default card also carries the author's own site and a "comment BASILISK" call to action.
skills.cover_note: 命令：`python3 scripts/build_basilisk.py`（仓库根，无外部依赖），出 basilisk.html 后 headless 截图，再裁掉下半的评语卡区，只留像素画。输入的 card.json 是我们编的 demo —— 但裁完之后画面里一个字都没有，编造的判词全在裁掉的部分。按「实质是形式」这一档收。
skills.cover_note_en: We installed it and ran it ourselves: `python3 scripts/build_basilisk.py`, screenshotted the generated HTML, then cropped to the pixel-art panel only. The card.json input was demo data we wrote — but the crop contains no text at all, so nothing fabricated is on display.

skills.name: see-life-wallpaper
skills.title_zh: 用草间弥生画孤独、米罗画温暖的每日五感壁纸
skills.tagline_zh: 今天闻到桂花、听见雨——一句感受配一段极细宋体和一张手写的抽象 SVG，直接渲成锁屏壁纸，图形还避开顶部时钟区。
skills.why_zh: 它给引用的诗人定了规矩：小字、低透明度，不能比你自己那句话抢风头。
skills.limit_zh: 默认输出尺寸是 1264×2780，也就是作者那台一加 13，其它机型要手动挑备选分辨率。渲染依赖 Playwright，成品自动复制到 ~/Downloads。六种情绪对应固定的六位艺术家和固定渐变，语录库是写死的一小批中西作者，超出这个范围就没有匹配项。
skills.title_en: Kusama for loneliness, Miró for warmth — a daily five-senses wallpaper
skills.tagline_en: You smelled osmanthus today, or heard rain. One sentence becomes hairline serif type over a hand-authored abstract SVG, rendered straight into a lock-screen wallpaper that keeps clear of the clock.
skills.why_en: The quoted poets are put on a leash: small type, low opacity, never allowed to upstage the line you wrote yourself.
skills.limit_en: The default output is 1264×2780 — the author's own OnePlus 13 — so other phones mean picking an alternate resolution by hand. Rendering needs Playwright, and finished files are copied to ~/Downloads. Six moods map to six fixed artists and six fixed gradients, and the quote bank is a small hard-coded set, so anything outside it has no match.

skills.name: fantasy-movie-poster
skills.title_zh: 中文竖版电影海报，9:16 锁死
skills.tagline_zh: 一场戏一张海报，字少，场面要像院线
skills.desc_en: Design original 9:16 Chinese-language cinematic movie posters from story briefs, genre keywords, or visual references, including layered cover workflows with separate image-designed background and typography layers. Use for romance, sports, historical/legal drama, road films, crime thrillers, war, Eastern ink, sci-fi isolation, ensemble casts, and playful concept films. Do not use to copy an exist
skills.why_zh: 从故事场面压成一张能上墙的中文电影海报，比例不许改。
skills.limit_zh: 不是横版大片，也不是剧照滤镜。要多页分镜，装不下。

skills.name: fitness-coach
skills.title_zh: 把长期健身做成有剧情的 RPG
skills.tagline_zh: 健身最难的是坚持，不是动作。它用本地文件记录你的训练、疲劳和复训，再让训练结果推进剧情——练得好剧情才往前走。
skills.tagline_en: Sticking with it is the hard part, not the movements. It keeps your sessions, fatigue and returns in local files, then lets the results move a storyline forward — train well and the plot advances.
skills.desc_en: 本地文件驱动的长期健身教练与可选 RPG 成长系统。用于用户开始或记录训练、制定或调整计划、复盘训练、复训、报告疲劳疼痛、查询历史表现，以及推进由训练结果驱动的剧情时。
skills.why_zh: 把「坚持」这个真问题用游戏机制解决，而不是再给一份训练计划表。全本地存档，数据不外传。
skills.why_en: It answers the real problem — consistency — with a game mechanic instead of yet another training plan. Everything stays on your machine.
skills.limit_zh: 数据全存本地 user-data/，换台机器就从零开始。没有 Python 环境时改由模型手写 JSON，脚本那层的单位和日期校验就失效了。
skills.limit_en: All data lives in a local user-data/ folder; switch machines and you start over. Without Python it falls back to the model hand-writing JSON, losing the script's unit and date checks.
skills.title_en: Long-term training as a story you unlock

skills.name: iching-divination
skills.title_zh: 用密码学随机数起卦的周易占卜
skills.tagline_zh: AI 算卦最没意思的是它会顺着你想听的编卦象。这个用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱，一事一占，凶卦如实直断，还能事后对账验证。
skills.tagline_en: The dull thing about AI fortune-telling is that it quietly tells you what you want to hear. This one casts three coins with a cryptographic RNG, allows one question per casting, states bad hexagrams plainly, and invites you back to check whether it was right.
skills.desc_en: 真随机起卦的周易/易经占卜。用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱起卦,绝不编造卦象;一事一占;按传统规范解读本卦、动爻、之卦,先引原文再讲白话;凶卦如实直断;支持事后对账验证。只要用户提到占卜、算卦、起卦、问卦、解卦、摇卦、占一卦、六十四卦、易经、周易、卦象,或想用易经视角推演某个决定(跳槽、感情、合作、出行、时机),就使用本 skill,即使他没有明说"占卜"二字。Authentic I Ching (Yijing/Zhouyi) divination - cryptographically random coin casting, classical hexagram interpretation
skills.why_zh: 「绝不编造卦象」「凶卦如实直断」——它把占卜里最容易滑坡的那两处堵死了。认真对待玩的东西，本身就是一种品味。
skills.why_en: It seals the two places divination usually slides: no inventing hexagrams, no softening a bad one. Taking a game seriously is itself a kind of taste.
skills.limit_zh: 一事一占是硬规矩，你连问几件它会引蒙卦拒绝。也不答彩票号码、不替你做医疗和财务决定。
skills.limit_en: One question per casting is enforced — ask several and it refuses, citing the Meng hexagram. It won't pick lottery numbers or make medical and financial decisions for you.
skills.title_en: Divination by I Ching, with cryptographic dice

skills.name: glitch-pixel-collage
skills.title_zh: 故障像素拼贴
skills.tagline_zh: 拼贴和故障是两套语法，不混装
skills.desc_en: Wibi Style 官方视觉风格。把用户上传的一张照片转换成乱码像素拼贴风格。适用于用户要求乱码像素拼贴、上传照片换风格，或明确调用 $glitch-pixel-collage 时。
skills.why_zh: 同一作者的另一件单风格。拼贴和故障是两套语法，不混装。
skills.limit_zh: 清晰度让路给故障。要干净印刷稿，别装这件。

skills.name: official-document-writing
skills.title_zh: 按 GB/T 9704 规范写党政机关公文
skills.tagline_zh: 请示、通知、函、纪要——体制内的公文错一个格式就要返工。它按国标给格式规范、模板和用语建议，还带质量检查。
skills.desc_en: 专业的党政机关公文写作指南。当用户需要撰写、修改或审核党政机关公文（如请示、通知、函、总结、纪要等）时使用。提供GB/T 9704-2012格式规范指导、常用公文模板、语言规范建议和公文质量检查。适用于以下场景：(1) 撰写新公文，(2) 修改完善公文，(3) 检查公文格式规范，(4) 提供公文写作指导，(5) 审核公文质量。
skills.why_zh: 极致垂直，而且是国外市场绝不会有的东西。作者引了具体国标号，说明他真的在这行里。
skills.unshelve_reason: C 端全球化转向（店主 2026-08-19）：党政机关公文是职业工具 + 中国体制限定，两条都不符合新方向。它本身质量没问题（引具体国标号、作者真在这行里），是定位不匹配，不是货不好。留档随时可翻回。
skills.limit_zh: 它管 GB/T 9704 的格式与用语，不管这份文该不该发、内容对不对。全文没写任何适用边界，实质内容还是你自己扛。
skills.limit_en: It covers GB/T 9704 formatting and register — not whether the document should be sent or whether its content is right. No stated boundaries anywhere in the skill.

skills.name: fengshui-master
skills.title_zh: 先说自己不算命的风水顾问
skills.tagline_zh: 看房时想问朝向旺位煞气，网上说法互相打架。它按三元玄空飞星、八宅明镜、形势峦头三套体系分开算，不合并成一个答案糊弄你。
skills.why_zh: 诚实段先引经典说风水辅佐不决定命运。一个会先缩小自己主张的术数，反而更好信。
skills.limit_zh: 三套体系常互相打架，并排展示不替你裁决。葬法地域差异极大，别当通例。
skills.tagline_en: You want to ask about orientation, favourable sectors and sha positions, and every source online contradicts the last. This runs three systems separately — Flying Star, Eight Mansions, and form-and-landform — instead of blending them into one confident answer.
skills.why_en: Its honesty section quotes the classics to say feng shui assists but does not determine fate. A practice that shrinks its own claim first is easier to trust.
skills.limit_en: The three systems routinely disagree with each other; it shows them side by side and won't adjudicate for you. Burial-site practice varies enormously by region — don't read it as a general rule.
skills.title_en: A feng shui adviser that opens by limiting itself

skills.name: TCM.Skill
skills.title_zh: 会劝你去挂急诊的中医参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 家里人不舒服，最难的是判断「要不要现在就去医院」。它把疑似致命的情况列成红线层——高热神昏、胸痛彻背、假神脱汗，一律叫急救不辨证。
skills.why_zh: 这类里我见过最安全的边界：先点名「传统框架拖成急诊」的失败模式，并在红线层直接拒绝辨证。
skills.limit_zh: 定位是「家庭参谋而非医师」，不出处方。针刺绝对禁止自行操作，只解释指路。教材派立场，与经方派、温病派的结论会不一致，它不替你调和。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 是中文「中医」，装上后可能不被识别，改成 tcm 更稳。 门面说不出处方，但硬约束文件给了 101 味毒性药的内服克数 —— 那是上限表，不是处方。
skills.tagline_en: The hard call at home is not which remedy — it's whether to go to hospital now. It puts suspected life-threatening presentations in a red-line tier: high fever with confusion, chest pain through to the back, cold sweat — call emergency services, no differentiation.
skills.why_en: The safest boundary I've seen in this category. It names the failure mode where a traditional framework delays real care, and refuses to be used there.
skills.limit_en: Positioned as a family adviser, not a physician; it writes no prescriptions. Self-administered acupuncture is forbidden outright, explanation only. It argues from the textbook tradition and will not reconcile itself with rival schools. Upstream's name field is Chinese, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to tcm. The facade writes no prescriptions, yet its hard-constraint file lists oral gram doses for 101 toxic herbs — read them as ceilings, not prescriptions.
skills.title_en: Traditional medicine that tells you to call an ambulance

skills.name: coc-kp-host
skills.title_zh: 写到第三段就把回合交回来的克苏鲁跑团 KP
skills.tagline_zh: AI 当 KP 最烦的是一口气把三个场景演完。它给自己设了硬上限：一回合一拍、2–4 句，停在你能动手的那一刻。
skills.why_zh: 队友 NPC 是 AI 扮的调查员不是提示频道：不许总结主线、不许给路线排正确度，要拿信息也得掷骰。
skills.limit_zh: 模组正文得你自己有——它明写有原文时不许凭记忆讲，没有原文就只能即兴。配乐是在浏览器里开一个搜索结果页，作者承认查不到具体曲目时就让你自己按播放。它还会照模组把 1920 年代的种族歧视当成线索门禁执行，只在开局前问你能接受到什么程度。
skills.tagline_en: The worst thing an AI Keeper does is play three scenes in one breath. This caps itself hard: one beat per turn, two to four sentences, stopping where you can act.
skills.why_en: Companion NPCs are run as AI-played investigators, not hint channels: they may not summarise the plot or rank routes by correctness, and must roll like anyone else to learn things.
skills.limit_en: You have to supply the scenario text yourself — the file forbids narrating from memory when canon exists, and without it the Keeper is improvising. Music opens a search-results page in your browser, and the author admits it tells you to hit play when a specific track cannot be verified. It will also enforce 1920s racism as a clue gate when the module calls for it, checking your comfort level only once before play.
skills.title_en: Hands the turn back the moment it starts a third paragraph

skills.name: hemingway-perspective
skills.title_zh: 用海明威的冰山理论帮你改写作
skills.tagline_zh: 想让文字硬一点、少一点形容词，却说不清怎么改。它用冰山理论、极简短句和硬汉式克制来回应——只谈写作，不扮演海明威本人。
skills.tagline_en: You want the prose harder and the adjectives gone but can't say how. It answers through iceberg theory, short declaratives and hard-boiled restraint — and it discusses writing only; it does not play Hemingway.
skills.desc_en: >- 用海明威的冰山理论、极简短句与硬汉式克制来回应写作与表达相关的问题 当用户明确要求使用这一人物的视角、提到“hemingway-perspective”，或希望应用其核心方法分析问题时使用；不要因一般性问题自动触发。
skills.why_zh: 「不要用来扮演本人」这条边界划得清醒：它做的是方法迁移，不是角色扮演。这个分寸是品味。
skills.why_en: 'Do not use this to impersonate the man' is a clear-eyed boundary: it transfers a method, it doesn't cosplay an author. That sense of proportion is taste.
skills.limit_zh: 作者明说不因一般问题自动触发，得你点名叫它。而且只对写作和表达类问题有用，拿它聊别的等于没装。
skills.limit_en: The author explicitly disables auto-triggering — you have to call it by name. It only helps with writing and expression; for anything else it may as well not be installed.
skills.title_en: Iceberg theory applied to your draft

skills.name: wujutong
skills.title_zh: 按三焦辨证给温病方，古人矛盾处照原样留着
skills.tagline_zh: 温病和伤寒是两套打法，用错了会反着治。它按《温病条辨》三焦辨证走，22 首方按上中下焦排开，359 个医案双索引。
skills.why_zh: 有一节叫「内部张力——保留，不调和」。古人自相矛盾处留着缝，并点名对立学派把你送过去。
skills.limit_zh: 只做温病；伤寒、杂病、气化学派不在范围，作者分别指路。不出处方；安全说明单独成节。
skills.tagline_en: Warm-disease theory and cold-damage theory are two different games; use the wrong one and you treat backwards. This follows the triple-burner differentiation, 22 core formulas laid out by burner, 359 case records double-indexed.
skills.why_en: One section is titled 'internal tensions — kept, not reconciled'. Where the classical author contradicts himself, it leaves the seam visible. It also names the rival school by skill and sends you there.
skills.limit_en: Warm disease only — cold damage, miscellaneous disease and the qi-dynamic school are out of scope and the author points each one elsewhere. No prescriptions; safety notice in its own section.
skills.title_en: Triple-burner differentiation for warm diseases — contradictions in the classics left standing

skills.name: chinese-baby-naming
skills.title_zh: 全家为起名吵架时出来当中间人
skills.tagline_zh: 起名难的从来不是想不出字，是爷爷要字辈、妈妈嫌笔画多、爸爸信五行。它专门做了协商模式，把冲突摆到台面上一条条谈。
skills.why_zh: 反模式写得清醒：没给出生时刻绝不伪造命盘；不为凑五行去用冷僻字——「孩子要写、要被叫一辈子」。
skills.limit_zh: 不做店名/品牌/宠物/游戏角色/虚构名，不做纯算命、不解读已有名字。方言校验只覆盖它掌握的语组。
skills.tagline_en: Naming a Chinese child is never short of characters — it's short of agreement: grandfather wants the generation character, mother says too many strokes, father wants the five elements balanced. It has a negotiation mode that puts the conflict on the table.
skills.why_en: The anti-patterns section is unusually clear-eyed: never fake a birth chart when no birth time was given, never reach for a rare character to balance the elements — 'the child will write it and hear it mispronounced for a lifetime'.
skills.limit_en: It refuses shops, brands, pets, game characters and fictional names, and won't do pure fortune-telling or interpret an existing name. Dialect checks cover only the language groups it knows; where it doesn't know, it says so.
skills.title_en: Mediating the family argument about the baby's name

skills.name: beijing-pollen-monitor
skills.title_zh: 查北京 16 区花粉浓度和过敏预报
skills.tagline_zh: 每年三四月对花粉过敏的人来说是渡劫。它拉 16 个站点的实时监测和分类预报，按区查，出门前知道今天该不该戴口罩。
skills.tagline_en: March and April are an ordeal if you're allergic. It pulls live readings and graded forecasts from 16 monitoring stations, queryable by district, so you know before you leave whether to mask up.
skills.desc_en: 查询北京花粉实时监测和预报数据，生成包含区级浓度、站点趋势、总量预报与分类预报的结果。北京 16 个固定站点，每区一个，用区名指定。 user-invocable: true argument-hint: "[report|overview|stations|history|forecast|daily] [--district 海淀] [options]"
skills.why_zh: 垂直到一个城市、一种过敏原——但对那批人是刚需。这种「窄得理直气壮」正是大市场覆盖不到的东西。
skills.why_en: Narrow to one city and one allergen — and for those people it's essential. That kind of unembarrassed narrowness is exactly what a large marketplace never covers.
skills.limit_zh: metadata 里明写要本机有 curl 和 jq，全靠 scripts/beijing-pollen-query.sh 打公开接口。范围钉死北京 16 区，作者写明北京以外不要用。而且它只查不推——「每天早上发我」那种晨报要调用方自己接。
skills.limit_en: Its metadata requires curl and jq locally and everything runs through one shell script against a public endpoint. Pinned to Beijing's 16 districts; the author says plainly not to use it elsewhere. It queries on demand and does not push.
skills.title_en: Pollen by district, for one city that needs it

skills.name: create-larp-character
skills.title_zh: 把剧本杀角色蒸馏成能继续聊天的 AI
skills.tagline_zh: 散场之后角色就没了，但你可能还想跟 ta 说话。丢进玩家本和人物小传 PDF，它拆出故事记忆和人物性格，生成一个能持续对话的角色。
skills.why_zh: 安全边界写着不泄露核心诡计和凶手、不透露该角色本不该知道的秘密——一个角色扮演工具主动防剧透，说明作者真在玩这个。
skills.limit_zh: 只用于个人情感体验，不该拿去帮别人过本。素材质量决定成品：小传写得薄，蒸馏出来的角色也薄。需要读写文件权限。
skills.tagline_en: The character disappears when the session ends, but you might still want to talk to them. Feed it the player script and character bio as PDF; it extracts story memory and personality into a character you can keep talking to.
skills.why_en: Its safety section refuses to leak the core trick or the culprit, and won't reveal what the character shouldn't know. A roleplay tool that guards against spoilers on its own is written by someone who actually plays.
skills.limit_en: For personal enjoyment only — not for helping someone else through a game they haven't played. Output quality follows the source: a thin bio yields a thin character. Needs file read/write permission.
skills.title_en: Keep talking to a murder-mystery character after the game

skills.name: feline-health-advisory
skills.title_zh: 替猫拦下云南白药和藿香正气的养猫参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 猫吐了、乱尿了、咬人了，中文经验帖和「打一下就记住」全是坑；它先过一遍急诊红旗再答，答案对齐国际猫科福利指南。
skills.why_zh: 它把「不给剂量」做成硬规则：连人用药折算、朋友说、写科普这几种绕法都点名堵死。
skills.limit_zh: 正文明写不给任何药物剂量、频次、疗程，即便用户声称兽医已给过指示也不替他补全。点名拒绝云南白药、藿香正气、蒙脱石散这类家庭偏方。只管猫不管狗；无法联网时不给召回、地区疫苗规则等当前结论，只讲原则和该去核验的官方渠道。
skills.title_en: The cat advisor that will not hand you a dose
skills.tagline_en: Vomiting, litter-box protests, biting — the folk remedies circulating online make it worse. This runs an emergency red-flag pass first, then answers from AAFP/ISFM welfare guidance.
skills.why_en: The refusal is hard-coded: no doses, and it names the loopholes it will not accept — "my vet already told me", "it's just for an article", "convert it by weight".
skills.limit_en: The file bars every drug dose, frequency and course, and will not fill gaps even when the user says a vet gave instructions. It names Yunnan Baiyao, Huoxiang Zhengqi and smectite as home remedies it refuses. Cats only. Offline, it gives principles and the official channels to check rather than current recall or regional vaccine rules.

skills.name: noir-interrogation
skills.title_zh: 用 SHA-256 锁死凶手的黑色电影审讯游戏
skills.tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你说服改口。这个把答案的哈希公示在开场简报里，你一间间审嫌疑人，它只照脚本发的卡演。
skills.why_zh: 困难模式会塞进一个指错人的假证人，而扮演那个嫌疑人的模型自己也不知道那是假的。
skills.limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分钟，单场结束就完，不做多线战役。只有黑色电影一种类型，中途要奇幻或科幻会被拒绝；两套设定是 1940 年代美式与 1930 年代民国上海。作者明写不许 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦绕过脚本，这个设计就作废了。
skills.title_en: A noir interrogation game that hashes the killer before you start
skills.tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
skills.why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
skills.limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.

skills.name: beachcombing
skills.title_zh: 把你必须几点前撤离滩涂顶在报告最前面的赶海参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 大潮那两小时能挖到什么、几点回头才不会被围住——它先算撤退时刻再谈收获，11 省 51 处点位带方言别名和吃法。
skills.why_zh: 最难得的是它给自己设了上限：走天文骨架估算时，适用性评分强制压到五档里的第二档，不假装精确。
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖中国大陆沿海，内置点库 11 省 51 处，其余靠 geocoding 兜底。没接真实潮汐 API 时走农历半日潮天文骨架，正文标「估算 ±1h」且评分不超过五档中的第二档。明确不做钓鱼预报、不做生物图像识别、不做休渔期与保护区的法律核对。
skills.title_en: The tide guide that leads with when you must be off the flats
skills.tagline_en: What is diggable in the two hours around a spring low tide, and when to turn back before the water closes in. Safe-exit time comes first, harvest second, across 51 sites in 11 coastal provinces.
skills.why_en: The rare part is the ceiling it puts on itself: when it falls back to an astronomical skeleton estimate, the suitability rating is capped at the second of five levels rather than faked.
skills.limit_en: Mainland Chinese coast only — 51 built-in sites across 11 provinces, everything else falls back to geocoding. Without a real tide API it computes a lunar semidiurnal skeleton, labelled "estimated ±1h" and capped at the second of five suitability levels. It explicitly declines fishing forecasts, species photo ID, and any legal check on closed seasons or protected areas.

skills.name: birdsight
skills.title_zh: 查稀有鸟最近落在哪，顺带说清中文名是台湾译名
skills.tagline_zh: 想知道这周末附近有没有稀有鸟、哪个热点在出货，它直连康奈尔 eBird 官方接口取真实观察记录，不靠模型记忆瞎编。
skills.why_zh: 20 个端点逐个实测过，还写明哪两个已经 404/403、别调；观测数据一律来自接口，不许凭训练知识补。
skills.limit_zh: 要自己去 ebird.org/api/keygen 申请免费 key，该 key 限非商业用途、并发超过 3 就 429。recent 端点最多回溯 30 天，全量历史得另申请 EBD。locale=zh 返回繁体台湾名（如「鉛色水鶇」），大陆常用名作者明说要自己维护别名表。
skills.title_en: Ask eBird who saw what bird, and where, this week
skills.tagline_en: Wondering whether anything rare has turned up near you this weekend, or which hotspot is producing — this queries Cornell's eBird API v2 directly for real sightings.
skills.why_en: All twenty endpoints were tested by hand, including the two that return 404 and 403 and are marked do-not-call. Sightings must come from the API, never from the model's memory.
skills.limit_en: You supply your own free key from ebird.org/api/keygen; free keys are non-commercial and start returning 429 above three concurrent requests. Recent-observation endpoints look back thirty days at most — full history needs a separate EBD request. Chinese common names come back in Taiwanese traditional form, and the author says to keep your own alias table rather than invent mainland ones.

skills.name: heat-risk
skills.title_zh: 用湿球温度算出 48℃ 的吐鲁番比长沙安全
skills.tagline_zh: 「今天能不能跑步、军训、开工」，看气温会看错。它拉 open-meteo 七天预报算湿球温度，按五级直接给行动建议。
skills.why_zh: 换掉了大家惯用的那把尺子：31℃ 湿球以上一切户外都危险，35℃ 是理论生存极限（PNAS 2010）。
skills.limit_zh: 只给风险等级和建议，不做诊断——正文最后一条是出现高热无汗、意识模糊立即就医。中文城市名查不到时要改传拼音（作者举的例子是 Dunhuang）。数据源单一，只有 open-meteo 的 7 天预报，没有实测站点校正。
skills.title_en: Wet-bulb math that puts 48°C in Turpan below 35°C in Changsha
skills.tagline_en: Deciding whether it is safe to run, drill or work outside today — air temperature will mislead you. This pulls a seven-day open-meteo forecast, computes wet-bulb, and grades five risk levels.
skills.why_en: It swaps out the scale people actually use: above 31°C wet-bulb all outdoor activity is dangerous, and 35°C is the theoretical survival limit, cited to Sherwood & Huber, PNAS 2010.
skills.limit_en: It grades risk and stops there — the file's closing line sends anyone with high fever without sweating, or confusion, straight to a hospital. Chinese city names that miss have to be retyped in pinyin (the worked example is Dunhuang). One data source only: the open-meteo seven-day forecast, with no station correction.

skills.name: human-allegory-engine
skills.title_zh: 把模板清单撞碎后重写的荒诞超短篇
skills.tagline_zh: 模型写小小说总是同一套：领导宣布、众人执行、底层受苦、老人落泪。它把这些列成模板清单，撞上就强制换两个维度重写。
skills.why_zh: 拒绝模仿任何具体作家的文风，只把要求翻译成冷幽默、荒诞因果、留白这些可迁移技法；结尾掏磨损物件这类套路直接禁止。
skills.limit_zh: 只写中文超短篇，上限 3000 字。默认只输出标题和正文，不给寓意、落点、创作说明。不把真实个人或机构写成加害者，不用地域/职业/贫困/残障做快捷笑点，不为煽情临时加死亡与重病。
skills.title_en: Absurdist flash fiction that breaks its own templates
skills.tagline_en: Models write the same parable every time. This lists those beats as a checklist and forces two dimensions to change on collision.
skills.why_en: Refuses named-author mimicry; translates requests into transferable craft. The worn-object ending is on the ban list, not the title.
skills.limit_en: Chinese flash only, ≤3000 chars. Title + story only by default. No real persons/orgs as villains; no region/job/poverty/disability joke shortcuts; no late death for pathos.

skills.name: pollen-query
skills.title_zh: 花粉季出门前查一眼，53 城都有
skills.tagline_zh: 三四月对过敏的人是渡劫，而多数天气 app 根本不报花粉。它拉中国天气网的监测站数据，给浓度等级、风险提示和 7 天历史加预报。
skills.why_zh: 多数天气 app 不报花粉；它用标准库直拉监测站，缺数就明说，不把扩散指数冒充浓度。
skills.limit_zh: 仅 53 个有监测站的城市；淡季报无、单日缺口正常。备用源是扩散指数不是浓度，别当同一个数。仅中国大陆。
skills.tagline_en: Allergy season is an ordeal and most weather apps don't report pollen at all. It pulls monitoring-station data for grade, risk note, and seven days of history plus forecast.
skills.why_en: Standard library only, nothing to install; the fallback source is kept clearly separate from the primary one, and when data is missing it says so rather than passing off a dispersal index as a concentration.
skills.limit_en: Only the 53 cities with monitoring stations; smaller cities have no data. Out of season it reports none, and gaps on individual days are normal. The fallback gives a dispersal index, not a concentration — don't read them as the same number. Mainland China only.
skills.title_en: Check pollen before you go out, 53 cities

skills.name: parenting-advisor
skills.title_zh: 专防「假托崔玉涛」文章的 0–13 岁育儿参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 孩子发烧、咬人、不肯吃饭时，最怕搜到一篇署名权威的假文章。它逼自己每个结论凑够两个独立来源，凑不够就明说降可信度。
skills.why_zh: 它给自己列了一张「AI 可能说的借口」对照表——「症状太典型了基本能确定」在表里是必须叫停的信号。
skills.limit_zh: 档案默认写进 Obsidian 式知识库的固定路径（08-全局记忆/L1-画像记忆/孩子名），没有知识库得先指定一个本地目录。覆盖 0–13 岁，只说「症状被关联到 XX」不说「得了 XX」，不推荐任何药品和剂量；输入命中呼吸困难、抽搐等词会跳过全部流程，只输出就医引导。
skills.title_en: A 0–13 parenting advisor that will not take one source's word for it
skills.tagline_en: Fever, biting, refusing food — the real hazard is landing on a convincing article falsely bylined to a famous pediatrician. This forces two independent authoritative sources per conclusion, or downgrades its own confidence out loud.
skills.why_en: It keeps a table of the excuses an AI is likely to make. "The symptoms are textbook, I can basically confirm it" is listed there as a signal to stop, not to proceed.
skills.limit_en: Profiles are written to a fixed Obsidian-style vault path, so without a vault you must nominate a local directory first. Ages 0–13. It says "this symptom has been associated with X", never "your child has X", and recommends no drug or dose. Words like breathing difficulty or seizure skip every workflow and return only a go-to-hospital message.

skills.name: ink-wash-poster
skills.title_zh: 照片收成水墨海报
skills.tagline_zh: 墨色和留白锁死，不是淡淡滤镜
skills.desc_en: Generate an ink-wash editorial poster prompt and the matching bitmap image from a user's theme, sentence, object, mood, article idea, photo, content brief, poem, memory, event, place, or other creative material. Use when the user wants a quiet, spacious, tactile ink-wash poster, cover, cultural visual, or reference-photo reinterpretation with thoughtful composition, paper texture, restrained typog
skills.why_zh: 按水墨海报的浓淡和空白重做照片，笔是结构不是装饰。
skills.limit_zh: 要彩色插画、要写实人像，墨会把你按回去。

skills.name: photo-revival
skills.title_zh: 日常快照收成手绘诗意稿
skills.tagline_zh: 普通现场留下，笔触盖上去，不像精修
skills.desc_en: Turn ordinary photos or everyday snapshots into poetic hand-drawn illustrations with large white-paper negative space, vivid localized color, subtle collage accents, and tiny handwritten captions. Use when a user wants a real photo reimagined as an illustration rather than filtered, beautified, or photorealistically edited.
skills.why_zh: 把随手拍抽成手绘插画，诗意在省略，不在加光。
skills.limit_zh: 要证件照、要原片细节全留，会画丢。

skills.name: photo-riso-poster
skills.title_zh: 照片收成孔版印刷海报
skills.tagline_zh: 套色和网点是规矩，不是复古滤镜
skills.desc_en: Turn a photo or a text theme into one quiet riso-print archive poster. For a photo, deconstruct its observable facts (counts, spacing, occlusion, direction, color roles) and rebuild them as a sparse 2–3 ink risograph composition on temperature-matched paper, with typography that also carries the evidence; for a text theme, distill one imageable idea. Aspect ratio follows the source photo. Generate
skills.why_zh: 按孔版印刷的套色层数做海报，颜色少、边毛、故意不准。
skills.limit_zh: 不是高清写真。要渐变商业海报，对不上。

skills.name: fantasy-minimal-magazine
skills.title_zh: 3:4 极简杂志封面
skills.tagline_zh: 编辑页的留白和字号，不是方图加字
skills.desc_en: Create FANTASY-branded 3:4 minimal editorial magazine posters from user-provided images by reading the image, reducing visual information, translating it into abstract editorial material, composing with large whitespace, and generating content-driven typography. Use when the user asks for "fantasy-极简杂志", "极简杂志海报", "编辑出版海报", "图片转译海报", "FANTASY magazine poster", or wants a quiet archival/minimal pub
skills.why_zh: 按杂志封面的格子重排主题。品牌味在版式里，不在滤镜里。
skills.limit_zh: 页是 3:4 封面。要长图文、要视频封面，格不对。

skills.name: chinese-style-poster-skill
skills.title_zh: 当代中式海报，配方锁在东方审美
skills.tagline_zh: 留白和印色是规矩，不是随便新中式
skills.desc_en: Create refined contemporary Chinese-style / Oriental aesthetic posters and poster-generation prompts from themes, titles, event information, brand copy, products, photos, architecture, intangible cultural heritage, cities, exhibitions, seasonal festivals, tea, incense, craft, museum, commercial brands, fashion, urban culture, editorial campaigns, or experimental cultural subjects. Use when the use
skills.why_zh: 当代东方海报的版式和色，按作者那套走，不跟国潮贴纸混。
skills.limit_zh: 不是喜茶那件，也不是水墨写意。要品牌 VI，另找。

skills.name: hand-drawn
skills.title_zh: 按手绘那一套出图，风格点名才动
skills.tagline_zh: 先报名，再画。不混装水彩和马克笔
skills.desc_en: Use when users ask for a hand-drawn or illustrated image prompt, name one of the repository's 18 numbered styles or the 3.1 stable variant, or mention triggers such as 亲子手绘、家庭蜡笔画、蜡笔、吉卜力、水墨、像素、淡彩速写、动画概念、水粉、北欧绘本、纸雕、软胶潮玩、墨线绘本、暖色扁平绘本、family-crayon-card、warm-flat-storybook. Produces prompt text or a formal reference-bearing call bundle and does not generate images.
skills.why_zh: 手绘不是一种滤镜。它要你说出用哪一种笔，才肯出那一种痕迹。
skills.limit_zh: 不是万能插画箱。不点名风格，它不知道画什么。

skills.name: pixel-style-poster-skill
skills.title_zh: 像素风海报，格点锁死
skills.tagline_zh: 格子是结构，不是加一层马赛克
skills.desc_en: Generate Pixel Style Poster prompts and matching raster images. Use when the user gives a theme, phrase, object, mood, photo, or content idea and wants a 3:4 editorial bitmap poster with a large fine dot-matrix subject, optional title-led or quiet microtype typography, close subject-text composition, optional colored-wash reverse halftone backgrounds, restrained color transitions, and low-resoluti
skills.why_zh: 按像素海报的格点重排主题，边要齐，色要少。
skills.limit_zh: 要高清写实、要渐变插画，格会对不上。

skills.name: gc-minimal-zine-poster-v0-3
skills.title_zh: 一句话收成极简刊物海报
skills.tagline_zh: 大留白、一处拼贴、一个色彩重音
skills.tagline_en: Hand it a sentence, an article, a mood or a photo and get a paper-textured minimal zine poster — vast negative space, one small collage anchor, experimental typography, a single clear color accent.
skills.desc_en: Generate or analyze poetic paper-texture minimal zine posters with large negative space, a small editorial collage or visual anchor, experimental typography, and one clear color accent. Use when the user gives a theme, sentence, article, mood, object, photo, content brief, reference images, or an image folder and wants a final poster image, a production-ready image prompt, reusable style rules, or
skills.why_zh: 卖的是克制。带自测集，作者在维护风格一致性。
skills.why_en: Rare in that what it sells is restraint — the hardest thing for a prompt to reproduce reliably. It ships an eval set, so the author is actually maintaining that consistency.
skills.limit_zh: 只出竖版纸感海报。字必须短，长文案会写糊。
skills.limit_en: Needs a built-in image tool, fed by referenced_image_paths or at most five in-session images. One form only: vertical, paper-textured, heavy negative space. Keep poster text short — image models garble long copy. On a fidelity miss it regenerates once, then says outright that it failed.
skills.title_en: Mostly empty posters, backed by an eval set

skills.name: moonlit-book-workflow
skills.title_zh: 给自家孩子做一本带家长配音的绘本
skills.tagline_zh: 12 页同一张脸，用你的声音读完
skills.tagline_en: Makes a 12-page personalized English picture book for your kid — a fixed watercolor house style plus a per-book character sheet keeps the child looking like the same character across all pages, narrated in a parent's own cloned voice, shipped as one sendable HTML file.
skills.desc_en: Build or resume a reusable 12-page personalized English picture book in a fixed watercolor house style, with a per-book character sheet for illustration consistency and local authorized-adult voice cloning for narration.
skills.why_zh: 固定水彩画风加角色设定图，保证每页都是同一个小孩，再用你自己的声音朗读，出一个能发出去的文件。
skills.why_en: It solves the hard parts: AI illustration usually drifts into a different-looking child each page, so it locks consistency with a style anchor plus a character sheet; voice cloning accepts only authorized adult recordings with guardian checkpoints, and private audio never ships in the output. Apple Silicon Mac + Codex only, ~3.2GB local model.
skills.limit_zh: 是英文 12 页绘本。要中文长篇、要每页换脸，会漂。

skills.name: human-writing
skills.title_zh: 按活人那套改中文长文
skills.tagline_zh: 知乎帖、人物故事、行业文，先删腔再写
skills.tagline_en: Makes Chinese read like a person who has seen things, checked sources and wants to explain properly — long answers, articles, scripts and dialogue alike.
skills.desc_en: 通用中文创作与改稿 Skill。用于知乎回答、论坛长帖、公众号文章、博客、评论、人物故事、历史叙事、新闻与行业解读、科普、教程、评测、个人叙事、小说、故事、对白、口播和演讲稿。默认写成一个见过事、查过材料、愿意把来龙去脉讲清楚的人在说话，重点保留中文互联网长回答与长帖的活人感和自然中文韵律，避免空泛的机构腔、喊口号式演说腔、营销腔和模型腔。非虚构长文先检查材料够不够，材料不足时研究、追问或缩短，绝不用重复解释灌字数。现实内容额外核验事实、引语、数据与用户亲历，虚构内容可以创造人物、场景、对白、心理与情节。成稿正文严禁冒号、破折号、“不是……而是……”及同类翻案句，并清除商业黑话和模型惯用黑话。不创建作者画像、个人规则库或个人写作 Skill。
skills.why_zh: 卡兹克这件卖的是中文现场的人味，不是通用润色按钮。
skills.why_en: Installing a specific human voice beats blacklisting AI words — the first governs syntax and point of view, the second only swaps vocabulary. Chinese original, not a translation.
skills.limit_zh: 不是短视频口播稿。要英文明信片、要公文，另装。
skills.limit_en: If a nonfiction piece cannot list five concrete pieces of material, it refuses to write long and caps you near 600 characters. Em dashes, signposting colons and "not A but B" framing are banned. check_prose.py checks hard bans only.
skills.title_en: Installs a voice instead of banning AI words

skills.name: punk-ip-article-illustrations
skills.title_zh: 把一张脸收成可复用的朋克角色
skills.tagline_zh: 先锁定角色，再出插图，不许中途换脸
skills.tagline_en: Upload one photo to mint your own IP character (with a four-view sheet), then send that character into every article you write — retro flat-3D vignette style, image count auto-scaled to article length.
skills.desc_en: Punk 出品的完整个人 IP 插图工作流：从用户上传的人物照片创建、修订、确认并持久化可复用角色，也可直接启用内置 Punk 角色；角色确认后读取完整文章、Markdown、网页、帖子或观点，自动决定数量并生成复古彩色扁平 3D 小剧场正文插图。适用于创建个人 IP、角色设定板、切换角色、文章自动配图、长文多图、流程拆解图和核心动作图等连续任务。
skills.why_zh: 从照片做出能反复用的角色，再进插图工作流。脸漂了就重来。
skills.why_en: Nails a real creator pain — not another article-illustrator, but a way to establish your own visual persona first, then reuse it across every piece. One consistent "you" running through all your content is a recognition moat. Photos stay local; no sensitive-attribute inference.
skills.limit_zh: 不是一次性贴纸。要每张换人，卸掉。
skills.limit_en: The character stays locked until you explicitly confirm it — drafts can't be activated, and handing it an article won't skip that gate. With no image tool on the host it returns prompts instead of pictures. Character packs stay local only.
skills.title_en: One photo, then that character appears in every article

Its curation webview also serves ANY image-candidate set (icons, logos, generated dr

skills.title_en: One line in, an engine-ready sprite sheet out

skills.title_en: Claude speaks caveman, your token bill drops

Detects and fixes patterns including: inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, passive voice, negative
skills.why_zh: 它列的「AI 写作臭味清单」具体到句式级别，反过来读就是一堂写作课。
skills.why_en: Its catalog of AI writing smells is specific down to the sentence pattern — read it backwards and it's a writing course.
skills.limit_zh: 35 条特征和全部例句都来自英文维基的 Signs of AI writing，破折号、弯引号、标题大小写那几条挪到中文基本落空。文件模式会直接把原文件改写成最终稿。
skills.limit_en: All 35 patterns and every example come from English Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing"; the em-dash, curly-quote and title-case rules do not carry over to Chinese. In file mode it rewrites your file in place, leaving only the final version.
skills.title_en: Deletes every "it's worth noting" you wrote

skills.name: doubt-driven-development
skills.title_zh: 怀疑驱动开发
skills.tagline_zh: 每个非平凡决策都要过一遍「新上下文对抗审查」：换一个干净脑子来挑刺攻击，站得住的方案才算数。
skills.tagline_en: Every non-trivial decision faces a fresh-context adversarial review — a clean mind attacks it; only survivors stand.
skills.desc_en: Subjects every non-trivial decision to a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands. Use when correctness matters more than speed, when working in unfamiliar code, when stakes are high (production, security-sensitive logic, irreversible operations), or any time a confident output would be cheaper to verify now than to debug later.
skills.why_zh: 对抗自己确认偏误的聪明设计：正确性优先的场景里，这一步价值极高。
skills.why_en: A clever weapon against your own confirmation bias — invaluable when correctness beats speed.

skills.name: interview-me
skills.title_zh: 逼问需求
skills.tagline_zh: 一次只问一个问题，把你「以为想要的」问成「真正想要的」，问到约 95% 确信才允许动手开工。
skills.tagline_en: One question at a time until ~95% confidence — extracting what you actually want, not what you think you should want.
skills.desc_en: Extracts what the user actually wants instead of what they think they should want. Achieves this through one-question-at-a-time interview until ~95% confidence about the underlying intent. Use when an ask is underspecified ("build me X" without "for whom" or "why now"), when the user explicitly invokes ("interview me", "grill me", "are we sure?", "stress-test my thinking"), or when you catch yours
skills.why_zh: 需求错了后面全白干，这个「先逼问再动手」的纪律省下的是整个项目的返工。
skills.why_en: Wrong requirements waste everything downstream; interrogation-first saves the whole project's rework.
